name: Knowing Gods Will
overview: Scripture reveals that knowing God's will involves trusting Him wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. His Word serves as a guiding light for our path, providing clarity and direction (Psalms 119:105). Though human plans abound, it is the counsel of the LORD that ultimately stands firm (Proverbs 19:21). Believers are called to seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, trusting that His good and peaceful purposes for us will be fulfilled (Jeremiah 29:11; Matthew 6:33), and to pray for His will to be done on earth as it is in heaven (Matthew 6:10).
